newsitem.title: USA: Sharon Energy sets placement of units.
newsitem.headline: Sharon Energy sets placement of units.

text.p: Sharon Energy Ltd said on Monday that Canaccord Capital Corp agreed to act as lead agent for a private placement of Sharon Energy common.
Under the agreement, the company will offer 2,000,000 units at a purchase price of CDN$0.50 each.
Each unit will consist of one common share and one common stock purchase Warrant. Each warrant is exercisable to purchase one common share within one year at CDN$0.60 per share.

As lead agent, Canaccord will receive a corporate finance fee of 150,000 common shares. There will be a seven percent commission to broker-dealers, as well as issuance of warrants to broker-dealers equivalent to 20 percent of the units sold. These warrants will allow the holder to purchase one common share for a period of up to one year at a price of CDN$0.50 per share, Sharon said.

The company said its proceeds are expected to be about CDN$900,000, which will be used primarily for the drilling of eight wells in four separate prospects in Sharon's northern Sacramento Basin natural gas exploration program.
